info.title: LanVault Desktop
info.description: TLS only. Connect to the QR IPv4/port while validating the QR CA, CA SPKI SHA-256 and stable hostname. No insecure TLS fallback, DNS dependency or remote administration. All Origin-bearing requests rejected. Local-only loopback-test is a CLI testing mode. Native clients required.

hostname.description: Use hostname from the local QR; connect to its provided IPv4 address with this SNI.

post.summary: Consume QR secret; wait for local Desktop approval
